Command: Examine Yourselves; Be of One Mind and Live in Peace
Summary: Paul's closing command to Corinth: examine yourselves whether you are in the faith, prove your own selves — and finally, be perfect, be of good comfort, be of one mind, live in peace.
Commandment: Examine yourselves, whether ye be in the faith; prove your own selves. Finally, brethren, farewell. Be perfect, be of good comfort, be of one mind, live in peace.
Application: Self-examination precedes the farewell blessing: the Corinthians who demanded proof of Christ in Paul are told to prove themselves. Unity and peace are the closing notes — the God of love and peace will be with a church that lives them.
Purpose: Scripture's own reason: 'the God of love and peace shall be with you' (2 Corinthians 13:11).
